text: Ericka Panamito Rueda Your partner has to update his address with PIBA (he can do this online if he hasn't moved in the previous year). Then he can email your visa department informing them of the move and the need to transfer the file to your new branch. He should also email the new visa department too (telling them where you have come from) to ensure the file is transferred correctly. Usually you don't need to go in person unless it is very urgent and you have an upcoming appointment in the next few months.
